newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close higher across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed higher across the board in moderate trade on some late local buying interest, brokers said on Friday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were also marked up slightly as the yen's weaker tone against the U.S. dollar triggered buying from individual investors in the afternoon.

"Prices were narrowly mixed in the morning, but prices turned firmer in the afternoon as some late local buying interest emerged. But activity was limited by lack of fresh incentives" a local broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, April RSS3 rose half a cent to 126.25 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 rose 0.75 cent to 182.00 Singapore cents (US$1.30) a kg.
April TSR20 rose half a cent to 171.50 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
